hardware.variant: YS-M33 tablet with an Allwinner A133 and retained vendor U-Boot.

inputs.name: NetBSD 11.1 (EMBER64) #0 AArch64 Image, built from the base revision and local candidate changes
Android v2 RAM boot container with that Image
Clean build of the EMBER64 AArch64 Image for the second boot
Android v2 RAM boot container for the second boot

scenario: At the vendor U-Boot prompt, set the UDISK root in the volatile boot arguments and control device tree. Boot the container from RAM.
expected: The general EMBER64 kernel selects the UDISK root without operator input at the kernel prompt.
observed: Both images reached rc and mounted UDISK on dk16 as a read-write FFS root without a root prompt. The clean build attached a133codec0, gt9xx0 and sunxilradc0. The tablet returned to its installed kernel after each test.
limits: Two RAM boots on one tablet with volatile loader settings. Board revision and test duration were not recorded.
The tests did not cover cold boot, persistent installation, graphics output, touch operation or WLAN association.
